finding: The M4/16GB machine and 12GB project cap support processed CRISPR matrices and source-paired API analysis, but not raw sequencing or whole-slide workflows.
All eight predeclared genes had 177 paired Broad/Sanger models; median gene-wise Spearman rho was 0.4222 and all correlations were positive.
The harmonized fc_clean_qn field is adequate for an engineering gate but not an untouched independent-replication endpoint.

Before WRN outcome access, the historical eligible colorectal cohort contained Broad 7 MSI/12 MSS, Sanger 10 MSI/19 MSS, and shared 6 MSI/7 MSS models; Broad failed the independent critic's proposed 8-per-class adequacy gate.
The preregistered processing-inflation hypothesis failed: median rho(fc_clean_qn)-rho(bf_scaled) was -0.0031 and only 4/8 genes favored fc_clean_qn, despite identical 177-model cohorts.

DepMap 26Q1 ScreenGeneEffect is explicitly library-corrected and is not a source-independent endpoint; 23Q4 source-separated naive scores are provenance-appropriate, but CRC-only Avana remains inadequate at 7 MSI models.

Broad Avana recovered the known MSI-WRN association across four tissues with stratified delta -0.7432, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.9377,-0.5019], permutation p=1/100001, and all four tissue effects negative.
Held-out Sanger KY confirmed the MSI-WRN association with stratified delta -0.9307, 95% bootstrap CI [-1.0000,-0.8133], permutation p=1/100001, and all four tissue effects negative.

Correction to the prior wording: KY is a sequentially gated confirmation contrast, not pristine unseen held-out values, because the first implementation parsed KY endpoints before the Avana gate. Numerical results and frozen gates were unchanged.

The four-tissue model-ordering design failed before outcome access: Endometrium had 5 overlapping Avana/KY models versus the independently frozen minimum of 8; no cross-source rank statistic was computed.
The preregistered two-tissue derived analysis passed: equal-tissue WRN rank agreement theta=0.5956, permutation p=13/100001, and paired-bootstrap 95% CI [0.2636,0.8114].
Ordering reliability was heterogeneous: Large Intestine rho=0.8211 versus Ovary rho=0.3701.
10/34 paired models had absolute source-percentile gaps >=0.25; A2780 was the largest gap at 0.7448, making technical-versus-biological discordance the next target.
Audit corrected the bootstrap to retain frozen full-denominator percentiles without reranking duplicates; compliant 95% CI is [0.3186,0.7870], and the scientific pass is unchanged.

The preregistered five-metric source-QC-rank-asymmetry hypothesis failed: equal-tissue association with WRN percentile gap theta=-0.0662, one-sided permutation p=0.6452, and fixed-rank bootstrap 95% CI [-0.3922,0.2780].
Tissue directions disagreed (Large Intestine rho=-0.2549; Ovary rho=0.1225), so broad screen-QC asymmetry does not provide a useful positive explanation of WRN ranking gaps in this frozen set.
All 34 paired models had zero annotated mutations across all four eligible Avana and five eligible KY WRN guide locations; source-asymmetry exposure was constant zero in both tissues.
The guide-site mutation candidate failed before outcome access; no WRN-gap association was computed, ruling out only variation in this specific official binary exposure for the frozen cohort.
The preregistered common-essential model-general discordance hypothesis failed: theta=0.1147, p=0.2614, fixed-rank bootstrap 95% CI [-0.2422,0.4396], with weak positive estimates in both tissues.
The separately frozen nonessential corroborative panel also failed and pointed slightly negative: theta=-0.1078, p=0.7272, CI [-0.4717,0.2683].

Across 1,227 common-essential and 618 nonessential controls, broad model-level cross-source discordance summaries did not explain the frozen WRN rank gaps; gene-specific and kinetic mechanisms remain open.
The preregistered sequence-inclusion-asymmetry hypothesis failed all primary gates: theta=0.0667, p=0.3542, fixed-rank bootstrap 95% CI [-0.2377,0.3391].
Tissue directions were heterogeneous: Large Intestine rho=-0.3679 and Ovary rho=0.5014; neither was used as a post hoc subgroup rescue.
The near-duplicate passing-sequence sensitivity exposure produced theta=0.0710 and the same failed conclusion; simple sequence-count asymmetry did not consistently explain WRN source gaps.
The frozen included-sequence guide-LFC reconstruction reproduced 100/103 official WRN screen scores but failed three, with maximum absolute discrepancy 0.575461 versus tolerance 1e-8.

All three reconstruction failures were exactly the records where nIncludedSequences exceeded nPassingSequences and one included row had PassesQC=False; this exposes a pipeline-semantics ambiguity but does not verify an alternative rule.
The preregistered no-drift gate stopped execution before gap parsing and before all nine guide omissions, so single-guide robustness remains unresolved and no rescue filter was tried.

The sole post-failure passing-sequence reconstruction matched 103/103 frozen official WRN screen scores within 1e-8; maximum absolute discrepancy was 5.551115123125783e-17, all three EXP-010 mismatch identities resolved, and no new mismatch appeared.

This result verifies only the passing-and-nonexcluded sequence aggregation rule for the frozen 103-screen WRN subset; it does not repair EXP-010, establish whole-release semantics, or answer single-guide robustness.

The passing-sequence baseline reproduced all 103 official WRN scores and all 34 frozen EXP-005 gaps before any omission; the nine global single-guide perturbations were therefore executed under the preregistered baseline.

Only 5/10 baseline-flagged cross-source WRN gaps remained flagged under every one of four Avana and five KY omissions, failing the preregistered >=8/10 robustness criterion; six were robust to all Avana omissions and six to all KY omissions.

The deterministic stress test produced 26 unflagged-to-flagged transitions across 216 possible events involving 10 unique models, with no p-values, confidence intervals, guide-quality causal analysis, or clinical interpretation computed.

The preregistered source-relative Chronos efficacy discordance association failed: equal-tissue theta=0.2071078431, one-sided permutation p=0.1220187798, and fixed-rank bootstrap 95% CI [-0.1697118656,0.5334215543]. Only the tissue-rho floor gate passed.

The final adequacy gate used one observation per paired ModelID: 17 distinct efficacy and growth exposures per tissue, largest tie 1. Growth was descriptive only, with theta=0.1139705882 and no p-value or confidence interval.

This is a frozen two-tissue same-assay association failure after an already-unsealed EXP-005 endpoint; it does not establish causality, mechanism, therapeutic relevance, patient benefit, or clinical utility.
